items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Jelly Roll knew him [Paul Merez] and Jelly Roll came over to see Paul

ctx.x: the New Orleans Rhythm Kings were probably the most popular jazz band in the country Jelly Roll Morton was just floating around and really couldn't get too much work around there and he was plugging tunes for Melrose Brothers Melrose Brothers asked Jelly Roll at least told him to go see Paul Merez you got some nice tunes here and he's from New Orleans and Jelly Roll knew him and Jelly Roll came over to see Paul and told him about the tunes he had and so forth and Paul had a session coming up with Jeanette Records…
